name: @gjsify/integration-undici
description: Integration tests: undici on GJS and Node. Validates @gjsify/{http,fetch,websocket} against the npm package every Node consumer uses (Node 18+'s fetch is undici under the hood). Ports a focused subset of undici's public API surface — fetch(), request(), WebSocket — against a local node:http / @gjsify/http server.

scripts.build:test:gjs: gjsify build src/test.mts --app gjs --globals auto,WebSocket --outfile dist/test.gjs.mjs
scripts.build:test: gjsify run build:test:node && gjsify run build:test:gjs
scripts.test: gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:node && gjsify run test:gjs

author: Pascal Garber <pascal@artandcode.studio>
